scope: Eight results connect pointwise continuation of warranted demand with a finite natural-weight event law. Event inclusion implies mass monotonicity, a positive newly covered event gives a strict increase, and preservation for all natural nonnegative weights is equivalent to inclusion via Dirac separation. A positive-total wrapper yields a necessary success-numerator floor for a pointwise undertaking. Event-level repair preserves the target and candidate and can add strict protection; its physical feasibility, permission and implementable routing are separate. Positive success under a fixed law can still miss a due, positive-mass support condition. Weights are event mass, not ethical importance. Coupling, coverage and normative warrant are supplied; no actual law is assumed freely variable, and no probability interpretation is given at zero total. No inherited project theorem is rebuilt.
